villagemaster/31314.htm.text: Warehouse Chief Donal: More than anyone else, we Dwarves know the importance of wealth -- but comraderie and trust are even more valuable. What price can you put on a clan member to whom you would entrust your life? If you have someone like that nearby, they are more precious than all the jewels in…

links.text: Listen to information about second class transfer.

Q00018_MeetingWithTheGoldenRam/31314-01..text: Warehouse Chief Donal: The Golden Ram Mercenary Force are in the the Swamp of Screams fighting stakatos. I'm looking for someone to deliver war supplies, are you interested?

Q00018_MeetingWithTheGoldenRam/31314-04..text: Warehouse Chief Donal: Get the supplies from my niece Daisy and take them to the Swamp of Screams.

Q00018_MeetingWithTheGoldenRam/31314-02..text: Warehouse Chief Donal: This is too difficult for you. (This quest may be undertaken only by characters of level 66 or above.)

Q00018_MeetingWithTheGoldenRam/31314-03..text: Warehouse Chief Donal: Get the supplies from my niece Daisy. I heard the Golden Ram might be recruiting if you are interested.
